scope: Independent read-only artifact, contract, source and numeric review; no app execution
caveats: Attempt3 passes final raw evidence and cleanup checks in its separately recorded /tmp destination. This does not retroactively validate either earlier failed attempt or identify the filesystem actor.
All metric arithmetic is raw-backed; no missing log was reconstructed.
A passing functional/envelope result is not blanket performance acceptance.
Positive deltas remain listed even when below the existing >1ms and >10% joint flag.
Source/harness bytes were reread; no application code was imported or executed.
Database full response/history payloads are not recorded by the original worker; this audit verifies their reported hashes agree, not independent hash derivation from absent payloads.
